enable_isatap.description: Enable ISATAP client mode — required to create and maintain the tunnel.

isatap_router_ipv4.description: IPv4 address of the ISATAP router — must be globally routable and reachable.

tunnel_interface.description: Name of the virtual tunnel interface to create (e.g., isatap0).

routers.description: List of static IPv4 addresses or hostnames for known ISATAP routers (optional, fallback to discovery). Items must be strings.
